instruction: Please update based on the comments.  Also the properties sections are missing.  Please for each profile go over each of the properties.

For the 'properties missing' ask, I went over each profile and expanded every lumped element row into per-property rows with individual descriptions (Protocol, Task, Location, Immunization, MedicationAdministration, SupplyDelivery, both Coverage profiles), so each profile's Properties table now covers each property. No version stamp on this doc, so none bumped.
